ron: Need a compact internal blurb for tomorrow's patch (v2.17.0). Ops wants copyable text + exact rollback path.

maya: Keep it 4 lines: what, impact, action, rollback. Include flag name and canary timing.

kevin: Draft below. Quick sanity-check pls.
kevin: • What: enable compact-prefix cache (flag: infra.cache.compact_prefix).
• Impact: ~9% p90 improvement for seq <=1024; no DB or analytics schema changes.
• Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.17.0 --canary 5 (30m) -> 25 (45m) -> prod. Pin: v2.17.0. Toggle in Console > Feature Flags.
• Rollback: if error rate +0.5% absolute OR p95 latency +20% for 30m -> disable infra.cache.compact_prefix + deploy tag v2.16.9.

sre-oncall: Oncall: @sre-oncall. I will monitor errors, p95, and host CPU. Abort in-thread if triggers hit.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: id=1755558888 env=staging tag=v2.17.0 canary=5%. Use `/deploy status 1755558888` for logs.

ron: Final pasteable block for #deploys: 
"""
:sparkles: What: compact-prefix cache (flag: infra.cache.compact_prefix).
:zap: Impact: ~9% p90 improvement for seq <=1024; no DB/schema changes.
:wrench: Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.17.0 --canary 5 (30m) -> 25 (45m) -> prod. Feature toggle in Console > Feature Flags. Pin: v2.17.0.
:rotating_light: Rollback: disable infra.cache.compact_prefix + deploy v2.16.9 if errors +0.5% absolute OR p95 +20% sustained for 30m.
"""

maya: Please add dashboard links when you post. I'll pin after deploy-bot updates.

kevin: Will post T-20 and add links. Saved to release-notes after live post.
